idea-plugin.name: CPH
idea-plugin.description:
A native Competitive Programming Helper for JetBrains IDEs.

Import problems with Competitive Companion, manage test cases, and compile, run, and judge solutions without leaving the IDE.

  • Kotlin-first support plus the full CPH language matrix.
  • Timeouts, cancellation, output differences, and Python custom checkers.
  • Portable testcase JSON and CPH-compatible metadata.
  • cph-submit and confirmed Kattis submission integration.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.1.1 fixes source-document saving on IntelliJ Platform 2025+ and flushes pending testcase edits before a run.

0.1.0 introduced the complete local judging and Competitive Companion workflow.
